mechanism: Amphetamine increases dopamine/norepinephrine activity while buspirone acts as a serotonin 5-HT1A partial agonist, creating potential additive CNS stimulation and serotonergic effects with risk of serotonin syndrome.
action: Monitor for signs of serotonin syndrome (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and excessive CNS stimulation; consider dose adjustment or alternative anxiolytic if adverse effects occur.
